exposure: Artificial Placenta (AP) utilizing extracorporeal life support (ECLS)
cohort: The participants were premature lambs delivered by C-section and assigned to an Artificial Placenta support group or two control groups sacrificed immediately after delivery.
finding: Premature lambs supported by an Artificial Placenta for 7 days demonstrated preserved small bowel mucosal architecture, higher cellular turnover (enterocyte proliferation and Paneth cells), and minimal evidence of injury compared to immediate sacrifice controls.
gest_age: 116-121 days GA (for AP group), 115-121 days and 125-131 days (for control groups), term=145 days
